# Axial Skyrmions
- The reflection in this context alters the sign of only one pion field, leading to a relative phase definition that differs by an addition of π compared to Refs. [3, 12, 7], where the antiSkyrmion is obtained by changing the sign of all three pion fields.
- The definition adopted in this paper allows for a more natural comparison with the analogous situation for monopoles.
- The profile function vanishes at a radius of s/2 from the center of the Skyrmion (or antiSkyrmion), enabling a continuous patching of the Skyrmion and antiSkyrmion, with fields set to the vacuum outside their cores.
- Beyond the initial conditions derived from the simple ansatz (3.7), more refined initial conditions were also employed, based on the rational map ansatz [11] with an axially symmetric charge n map.
